selected_script.angle: Trying to chip off dried, hardened grease on an oven exterior with a plastic spatula just risks snapping the tool; Liapu spray effortlessly melts the stubborn dots for a one-swipe clean across ovens, microwaves, and BBQ stations.
selected_script.hook: Stop trying to scrape baked-on grease with a plastic spatula—you're just going to snap it.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video. Realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-3s: Close up POV. A hand awkwardly bends a plastic spatula trying to scrape dried, amber-colored hard grease spots from a stainless steel oven exterior. The grease stays stuck. 3-6s: A hand brings in the white Liapu spray bottle (yellow label) and sprays mist over the hard grease. It softens instantly and is wiped away with a paper towel. 6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing the pristine, shiny oven exterior with zero residue. Maintain exact product identity from the reference image. Keep pacing fast and product-focused. Do not end with a CTA.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video. Continuation of the previous segment. Realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-4s: Fast-cut scene 2. Hand sprays Liapu onto a sticky, greasy microwave button panel and wipes it crystal clear with one swipe. 4-8s: Fast-cut scene 3. Spraying and effortlessly wiping thick greasy drips off an outdoor BBQ side table, leaving a spotless finish. 8-10s: Short CTA. The Liapu spray bottle rests prominently on a sparkling clean kitchen counter next to a fresh lemon. Maintain exact product identity from the reference image. No generated text or logos.
